$comment: The health shape both sides must serve. rule 7 of record-spec.md: the same static page renders
a local cell (discuss-api /projects/{p}/health) or a central factory (discuss-record
/v1/factories/{f}/health) with no branch, so a field renamed on one side and not the other is a
silent break. Each repo has a test that decodes its own /health and checks every row against the
field lists below; that pair of tests is gate item 5's mechanism.
The record nests the same agents/threads blocks under cells[] and adds a push block; the two
flags under record_only exist only there, because only the record has the time series to compute
them. A reader treats a missing flag as false.
record/specs/health-golden.json is a byte-identical copy, so the record's tests still run once it
is cloned alone on PLV's host. The record's own test fails if the two ever differ.
